justification: The for-property route served every council's rules when called without former_council (its only council filter). Live 2026-10-21: lga=Bayside&zone=R2&topic=parking returned 1,980 rules from 12 other councils. The AI router treated lga alone as a council scope and could send that call. Separately the general/use layers were capped at 3,000 rows and the HCA query at 2,000 with no signal when the cap bit.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Measured: with both guards replaced by if (false), 2 of 4 tests fail (the lga-only 400 and the 3,001-row failure). Restored: 4/4 pass; the 9 route/router suites pass 57/57.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The live production API: lga-only call returned 1,980 rows from 12 councils; council-scoped widest case (Marrickville, heritage=true, no zone) returned 2,684 general rows, below the 3,000 cap; CB R2 with council 1,677.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Both guards set to if (false): npx jest on the new file = 2 failed, 2 passed (lga-only returned 200 not 400; 3,001 rows returned 200 not 500). Restored: 4 passed.

pre_impl.existing_data: All mounted callers checked on origin/main: ProvisionsByTocStructure only fetches when formerCouncil is set; ProvisionsByTopic, useFullPropertyData and useFullAssessment are not mounted; lib/ai/router.ts is mounted via /api/ai/chat and allowed lga-only.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The plan assumed the 3,000 cut-off dropped Marrickville rules per house. It does not: the exact 3,000+3,000 seen for CB came from calls without former_council, i.e. the cross-council leak, not a council over the cap.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One guard at the top of GET, one helper next to the caps, LIMIT cap+1 on the two capped queries, one-line router scope change. One new test file following citation-checked-for-property.test.ts.

functions.name: assertWithinCap
functions.input: row count from a query fetched with LIMIT cap+1
functions.output: throws when count > cap; GET's catch returns 500 with the message in details
functions.if_none: 0 rows is within cap and passes through as before

values.if_missing: without it the leak is a code-reading claim only

values.value: Marrickville heritage=true no zone: 2,684 general rows
values.if_missing: without it there is no measure of headroom under the 3,000 cap

residual_risk: A client that omits former_council now gets a 400 rather than wrong rules; the address page never does, the unmounted hooks would. Marrickville headroom is ~316 rows; if it grows past 3,000 the page errors instead of dropping rules, which is the intended trade.

break_it.scenario: A caller passes lga but no former_council (AI chat with no formerCouncil).
break_it.test: refuses an lga-only request before any rule query
break_it.how: Route returns 400 before any rule query; router now refuses first and says the council is not known.
break_it.what_happens: Before: 200 with 1,980 rules from 12 other councils, read as this property's rules.

break_it.scenario: A council grows past 3,000 live general rules after its filters (Marrickville is at 2,684 widest).
break_it.test: fails the request when a layer has more rows than the cap
break_it.how: Query fetches 3,001, assertWithinCap throws, GET returns 500 with the reason in details; the page shows an error, not a short list.
break_it.repro: npx jest __tests__/api/for-property-council-and-cap.test.ts -t 'more rows than the cap'
break_it.what_happens: Before: the extra rows were dropped silently and the page looked complete.

break_it.scenario: Exactly 3,000 rows: off-by-one would refuse a complete answer.
break_it.test: serves a layer at exactly the cap
break_it.what_happens: An off-by-one guard would refuse a complete 3,000-row answer.

break_it.scenario: Someone lowers LIMIT back to the cap, so the extra row never comes back and the guard can never fire.
break_it.test: asks the database for one row more than the cap
break_it.how: SQL assertion fails: every layer query must say LIMIT 3001.
break_it.repro: set LIMIT ${LAYER_ROW_CAP} in route.ts, then npx jest __tests__/api/for-property-council-and-cap.test.ts -t 'one row more'
break_it.what_happens: With LIMIT at the cap the guard can never see the extra row and is dead code.

mutation_analysis: Run, not described: guards replaced by if (false) -> 2 of 4 fail. The LIMIT 3001 test guards against the guard being made unreachable.

post_merge.db_reset: No. No database write; read-only route change.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: after deploy, curl /api/provisions/for-property?lga=Bayside&zone=R2&topic=parking must return 400, and former_council=Marrickville&zone=R2 must still return 1,786 general rules.
